verdict.reasons: Core identity and technical evidence are present: the authentic white-and-blue cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton is recognizable and integrated into a plausible agronomic scene with neutral seedlings and localized root-zone irrigation. The main 'AFP' logo, Persian text, and the required phone watermark are authentic and readable. However, the image includes a second commercial product — a coiled black hose laid on the soil next to the tape carton. Per the identity rules, this constitutes a mixed commercial product family ('hose' vs. 'tape20') and violates the expected product count of 1. This is a core identity rejection because the black coiled hose is not a valid supporting infrastructure item or an installed lateral; it is presented as a separate commercial item. The scene otherwise meets visual quality standards.

focused_physical_review.reason: A black coiled lateral is positioned immediately adjacent to the required AFP package. The proximity of the coil restricts the space such that a broad uninterrupted soil gap is not visible around the complete footprint of the carton. The distinct physical separation of the coiled lateral from the carton's base and circumference constitutes a line touching or crossing the package axis. The coiled lateral is identified as an extra loose product coil outside the required packaging.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
Independent physical condition not met: line_touches_or_crosses_package
Independent physical condition not met: extra_loose_product_coil
